title.zh-Hant: 孕期飲食與美國超市採買指南
title.en: Pregnancy nutrition and U.S. grocery guide

summary.zh-Hant: 營養素優先順序、魚類汞分級、Trader Joe's / Whole Foods 採買清單、食安三級。
summary.en: Nutrient priorities, fish mercury tiers, Trader Joe's and Whole Foods shopping lists, food-safety tiers.

title.zh-Hant: 懷孕期間運動指南（第一孕期）
title.en: Exercise during pregnancy (first trimester)

summary.zh-Hant: 運動模式延續、與教練溝通、強度判斷、重量上限與硬舉、骨盆底肌訓練、停止運動警訊。
summary.en: Keeping your routine, talking to your trainer, judging intensity, lifting limits, pelvic floor training, warning signs to stop.

title.zh-Hant: 孕早期快結束了：先把這 4 件事排進行事曆
title.en: The first trimester is almost over: put these 4 things on your calendar

summary.zh-Hant: 流感疫苗任何孕期都能打；約第 20 週照解剖超音波；24–28 週驗妊娠糖尿病；27–36 週打百日咳疫苗。每一件都多問一句：為什麼是這個時間？
summary.en: Flu shot any trimester; anatomy ultrasound around week 20; gestational diabetes screening in weeks 24–28; Tdap in weeks 27–36. For each: why this timing?

q.zh-Hant: 媽媽以前得過流感或打過疫苗，懷孕為什麼還要再打？
q.en: If mom has had flu or a flu shot before, why get one in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 病毒每年在變、舊保護會下降；懷孕時比較容易重症；寶寶滿 6 個月前不能打，要靠媽媽傳給他的抗體。
a.en: Viruses change and old protection fades; pregnancy makes severe flu more likely; and the baby can't be vaccinated until 6 months, so it relies on antibodies from mom.

q.zh-Hant: 百日咳疫苗為什麼建議在 27–36 週的前段打？
q.en: Why is Tdap best given early in weeks 27–36?

a.zh-Hant: 抗體約 2 週到高峰，傳給寶寶還需要時間，而媽媽的抗體會隨時間下降；早一點打，生產時抗體還高、也來得及傳給寶寶。
a.en: Antibodies peak about 2 weeks after the shot, transfer takes time, and mom's levels fall; earlier in the window keeps levels high at birth with time to reach the baby.

q.zh-Hant: 第 20 週左右的超音波主要看什麼？能抓到所有問題嗎？
q.en: What does the week-20 ultrasound look at, and does it catch everything?

a.zh-Hant: 看心臟、腎臟、四肢等構造，但無法排除所有異常；MedlinePlus 概估可偵測約半數，實際依異常種類與檢查條件而異。
a.en: The heart, kidneys, limbs and other anatomy. Not every anomaly can be ruled out: MedlinePlus broadly estimates half can be detected, with rates varying by anomaly and scan conditions.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼妊娠糖尿病篩檢排在 24–28 週？
q.en: Why is gestational diabetes screening done in weeks 24–28?

a.zh-Hant: 懷孕荷爾蒙造成的胰島素阻抗越來越明顯，妊娠糖尿病通常在第 24 週左右才出現。
a.en: Insulin resistance from pregnancy hormones builds up, and gestational diabetes usually appears around week 24.

q.zh-Hant: Tdap 為什麼每一胎都要打？
q.en: Why is Tdap given in every pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 它的作用是讓媽媽在出生前把抗體傳給這一個寶寶，每個寶寶都需要自己那一次。
a.en: Its job is to pass antibodies to this particular baby before birth, and each baby needs its own transfer.

title.zh-Hant: 產檢也能請有薪假：紐約多給你 20 小時，不用動到病假
title.en: Prenatal appointments come with paid time off in New York: 20 hours, on top of sick leave

summary.zh-Hant: 紐約州私部門員工每 52 週有 20 小時有薪產檢假，按小時請、不必說明檢查內容，但只有孕婦本人能用。寶寶出生後，接手的是父母都能請的有薪家庭假。
summary.en: Private-sector workers in New York get 20 hours of Paid Prenatal Leave per 52 weeks, usable by the hour with no need to say what the visit is, but only by the pregnant person. After the birth, Paid Family Leave takes over for both parents.

q.zh-Hant: 已經有病假了，為什麼產檢還要特地用產檢假？
q.en: You have sick leave, so why use Paid Prenatal Leave for appointments?

a.zh-Hant: 因為那 20 小時是額外的，不從病假扣；先用它，病假就能留給真的生病。雇主也不能強迫你改用別的假。
a.en: The 20 hours are extra and don't come out of sick leave, so using them first saves sick days for illness. Your employer can't make you use another type instead.

q.zh-Hant: 伴侶陪產檢可以用這 20 小時嗎？
q.en: Can a partner use the 20 hours to come to appointments?

a.zh-Hant: 不行，只有懷孕的人本人能用。伴侶的假是出生後的有薪家庭假。
a.en: No, only the pregnant person can. The partner's leave is Paid Family Leave after the birth.

q.zh-Hant: 請產檢假時，要告訴雇主是什麼檢查嗎？
q.en: Do you have to tell your employer what the appointment is for?

a.zh-Hant: 不用。雇主不能問健康資訊或看診原因，也不能要求病歷。
a.en: No. Your employer can't ask for health information or the reason, or require medical records.

q.zh-Hant: 有薪家庭假可以在生產前開始嗎？要多早通知？
q.en: Can Paid Family Leave start before the birth, and how much notice is needed?

a.zh-Hant: 不行，出生後才能開始，並要在 12 個月內請完；可預見時至少 30 天前通知雇主。
a.en: No. It starts only after the birth and must be used within 12 months; give at least 30 days' notice when foreseeable.

q.zh-Hant: 產檢假沒用完會怎樣？
q.en: What happens to unused prenatal leave hours?

a.zh-Hant: 不會帶到下一期，也不會折現，而且不能用在產後照護。52 週從第一次使用開始算。
a.en: They don't roll over or get paid out, and they can't be used for care after pregnancy. The 52 weeks start at first use.

title.zh-Hant: 憂鬱不一定等到產後：孕期就能預防，諮商讓風險少近 4 成
title.en: Depression doesn't wait for the birth: it can be prevented in pregnancy, and counseling cuts the risk by about 40%

summary.zh-Hant: 圍產期憂鬱從懷孕期間就可能開始，伴侶也會遇到。風險較高的人在孕期接受 CBT 或 IPT 諮商，發生風險約低 4 成；產檢時主動提心情，並把紐約可用的專線存起來。
summary.en: Perinatal depression can start in pregnancy, and partners can be affected too. For people at higher risk, CBT or IPT counseling lowers the risk by about 40%. Bring up your mood at prenatal visits and save the hotlines available in New York.

q.zh-Hant: 圍產期憂鬱涵蓋哪一段時間？
q.en: What time span does perinatal depression cover?

a.zh-Hant: 懷孕期間到產後 1 年。孕期的憂鬱沒治療，可能變重並延續到產後。
a.en: Pregnancy through 1 year after birth. Untreated depression in pregnancy can worsen and continue after the birth.

q.zh-Hant: 還沒有憂鬱，為什麼高風險的人現在就該談諮商？
q.en: If you're not depressed yet, why should a higher-risk person talk about counseling now?

a.zh-Hant: 因為諮商是「預防」：17 個試驗、3,094 人的合併結果，接受諮商的人發生圍產期憂鬱的風險比是 0.61，約低 4 成。
a.en: Because counseling is prevention: pooling 17 trials with 3,094 people, counseling groups had a risk ratio of 0.61, about 40% lower risk of perinatal depression.

q.zh-Hant: USPSTF 舉了哪些「風險較高」的例子？
q.en: What examples of "higher risk" does the USPSTF give?

a.zh-Hant: 曾有憂鬱病史、目前有尚未達臨床診斷門檻的憂鬱症狀，或低收入、年輕或單親等社經因素。
a.en: A history of depression, current depressive symptoms below a diagnostic threshold, or socioeconomic factors such as low income or young or single parenthood.

q.zh-Hant: 伴侶也會有圍產期情緒問題嗎？
q.en: Can partners have perinatal mood problems too?

a.zh-Hant: 會。紐約州心理衛生廳指出約每 10 位伴侶有 1 位。
a.en: Yes. The NY State Office of Mental Health says about 1 in 10 partners do.

q.zh-Hant: 全國孕產婦心理健康專線怎麼聯絡？
q.en: How do you reach the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline?

a.zh-Hant: 打電話或傳簡訊到 1-833-TLC-MAMA（1-833-852-6262），免費、保密、24 小時，有英語、西班牙語及中文口譯，伴侶也能使用。
a.en: Call or text 1-833-TLC-MAMA (1-833-852-6262): free, confidential, 24/7, with English, Spanish and interpreter support (including Chinese); partners can call too.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶早就在動了，你只是還感覺不到：第一次胎動多在 16–24 週
title.en: Your baby is already moving, you just can't feel it yet: first movements usually come at 16–24 weeks

summary.zh-Hant: 寶寶從孕早期就開始動，因為活動能幫關節、肌肉和骨骼發育；但要到 16–24 週才感覺得到，第一胎或前壁胎盤可能更晚。24 週還沒感覺就告訴醫護；之後胎動變少，立刻打電話。
summary.en: The baby starts moving early in pregnancy because movement helps build joints, muscles and bones, but you usually feel it only at 16–24 weeks, later with a first baby or an anterior placenta. Tell your provider if there's nothing by 24 weeks; later, call right away if movement drops.

q.zh-Hant: 多數人第一次感覺到胎動是在第幾週？第一胎呢？
q.en: When do most people first feel the baby move? And with a first baby?

a.zh-Hant: 16 到 24 週之間；第一胎可能要過了 20 週。
a.en: Between 16 and 24 weeks; with a first baby, possibly not until after 20 weeks.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶為什麼需要在子宮裡動？
q.en: Why does the baby need to move in the uterus?

a.zh-Hant: 胎兒本身的活動有助於關節、肌肉和骨骼發育；嚴重、持續的活動受限可能涉及先天性關節攣縮。這和孕早期媽媽感覺不到胎動不同。
a.en: Fetal movement helps develop joints, muscles and bones. Severe, prolonged restriction of movement can be involved in congenital joint contractures; this is different from not feeling kicks early in pregnancy.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼前壁胎盤會讓人比較晚感覺到胎動？
q.en: Why can an anterior placenta delay feeling movement?

a.zh-Hant: 因為胎盤位在子宮和肚皮之間，可能讓第一次胎動較難感覺到。
a.en: Because the placenta sits between the uterus and the belly wall, which may make the first movements harder to feel.

q.zh-Hant: 之後如果胎動變少或模式改變，該怎麼做？
q.en: Later on, what should you do if movement drops or the pattern changes?

a.zh-Hant: 立刻打電話給產科或產房，不要等到隔天，半夜也一樣。不要用家用胎心儀自己聽：聽到心跳不代表寶寶沒事。
a.en: Call your OB or labor and delivery right away, without waiting for the next day, even at night. Don't check with a home doppler: hearing a heartbeat doesn't mean the baby is well.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶何時能聽見你說話？不同醫學資料相差幾週
title.en: When can your baby hear your voice? Medical sources differ by weeks

summary.zh-Hant: 胎兒約 18 週開始聽見體內的聲音；外界人聲的時程各家略有差異，NHS 指出約 24 週，AAP 則說約 27–29 週。日常說話或唱歌能讓聲音變熟悉，不做也不必內疚。孕期應避開非常大的噪音與低頻震動；耳塞不能完全保護胎兒。
summary.en: Fetuses begin hearing sounds inside the body around week 18. Guidance varies on outside voices: NHS says around week 24, while AAP says around weeks 27–29. Talking or singing can make your voice familiar, but it is optional. Avoid very loud noise and low-frequency rumble during pregnancy; earplugs do not fully protect the fetus.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶大約幾週開始聽得到你身體裡的聲音？什麼時候聽得到外面的聲音，像你說話？
q.en: Around when does the baby start hearing sounds inside your body? And outside sounds, like your voice?

a.zh-Hant: AAP 說約 18 週聽得到心跳等身體裡的聲音，27 到 29 週左右聽得到外面的聲音，包括你說話。
a.en: AAP says about 18 weeks for body sounds like your heartbeat, and around 27 to 29 weeks for outside sounds, including your voice.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶出生前聽不懂話，為什麼還值得跟他說話、唱歌？
q.en: The baby can't understand words before birth, so why is talking and singing still worth it?

a.zh-Hant: 不是為了教他，而是讓聲音變熟悉：反覆聽到的聲音寶寶會認得，出生後熟悉的歌、書和你的聲音能安撫他。新生兒研究也看到，子宮裡聽到的語言會影響出生後對母音的反應。
a.en: Not to teach, but to make sounds familiar: babies recognize sounds they hear over and over, and after birth familiar songs, books and your voice can comfort them. A newborn study also found that language heard in the womb shapes how babies respond to vowels after birth.

q.zh-Hant: 在很吵的地方戴耳塞，能保護肚子裡的寶寶嗎？
q.en: Does wearing earplugs in a loud place protect the baby?

a.zh-Hant: 不能完全保護。聲音會穿過身體傳進子宮；CDC 建議孕期就算戴著聽力防護，也避開超過 115 分貝（約電鋸）的地方。
a.en: Not fully. Sound travels through the body into the womb; CDC advises avoiding places louder than 115 dBA (about a chainsaw) during pregnancy, even with hearing protection.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼低頻的轟隆聲、震動要特別避開？
q.en: Why should you especially avoid low-frequency rumble and vibration?

a.zh-Hant: 因為低頻聲音比高頻更容易穿過身體，傳到寶寶那裡。
a.en: Because low-frequency sound travels through the body, and to the baby, more easily than high-frequency sound.

title.zh-Hant: 懷孕可以看牙醫嗎？照 X 光、打麻藥都安全，別拖到產後
title.en: Can you see the dentist while pregnant? X-rays and numbing shots are safe, so don't wait until after the birth

summary.zh-Hant: CDC 與 HRSA 都說牙科治療在懷孕任何階段都安全，包括 X 光、局部麻醉、補牙和根管治療；只有鎮靜、笑氣、全身麻醉和用藥要先問產科醫師。荷爾蒙讓牙齦更容易發炎，產後蛀牙細菌也可能傳給寶寶，所以趁孕期處理。治療牙周病能否降低早產，目前證據還不確定。
summary.en: The CDC and HRSA say dental care is safe at any stage of pregnancy, including X-rays, numbing shots, fillings and root canals; only sedation, nitrous oxide, general anesthesia and medicines need your OB's input first. Hormones make gums more easily inflamed and cavity bacteria can pass to the baby after birth, so get care now. Whether treating gum disease lowers preterm birth is still uncertain.

q.zh-Hant: 懷孕時照牙齒 X 光、打局部麻醉安全嗎？
q.en: Are dental X-rays and numbing shots safe in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 有臨床需要的牙科 X 光和局部麻醉在孕期可以安全進行。ADA 不再建議例行穿鉛衣，但紐約州法律仍要求照牙科 X 光時保護軀幹與甲狀腺（甲狀腺護罩有特定例外）。靜脈鎮靜、笑氣、全身麻醉及用藥須先與產科討論。
a.en: Clinically indicated dental X-rays and local anesthesia are safe during pregnancy. The ADA no longer routinely recommends lead aprons, but New York law still requires torso and thyroid shielding during dental X-rays (with a limited thyroid exception). Discuss IV sedation, nitrous oxide, general anesthesia and medicines with the OB.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼懷孕更容易牙齦發炎？
q.en: Why are gums more likely to get inflamed in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 孕期荷爾蒙會讓牙齦對牙菌斑細菌的反應變得誇大，同樣的細菌引起更明顯的紅腫。
a.en: Pregnancy hormones exaggerate the gums' response to plaque bacteria, so the same bacteria cause more redness and swelling.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼蛀牙最好在寶寶出生前處理，而不是等生完？
q.en: Why treat cavities before the baby is born rather than after?

a.zh-Hant: 拖延可能讓問題更複雜；而且產後致蛀牙細菌可能透過親吻等方式傳給寶寶，媽媽有很多未治療蛀牙時，孩子將來蛀牙的風險約高 3 倍。
a.en: Delay can make problems more complex, and after birth cavity-causing bacteria can pass to the baby through things like kisses; when a mother has many untreated cavities, the child's future cavity risk is about 3 times higher.

q.zh-Hant: 孕吐之後，怎麼保護牙齒？
q.en: After vomiting, how do you protect your teeth?

a.zh-Hant: 不要馬上刷牙，先用 1 杯水加 1 茶匙小蘇打漱口。
a.en: Don't brush right away; rinse first with 1 teaspoon of baking soda in a cup of water.

q.zh-Hant: 治療牙周病已經證明能預防早產嗎？
q.en: Has treating gum disease been proven to prevent preterm birth?

a.zh-Hant: 還沒有定論。2026 年合併 14 項試驗、8,316 人的研究顯示整體可能有降低早產的趨勢，但信賴區間跨過 1；加用 chlorhexidine 漱口水的效果證據確定性很低。孕期仍應為口腔健康接受需要的牙科治療。
a.en: Not conclusively. A 2026 review of 14 trials and 8,316 participants showed a possible lower preterm-birth risk, but the confidence interval included no effect; evidence for additional chlorhexidine mouthwash was very uncertain. Dental care remains important for oral health.

title.zh-Hant: 找托嬰別只靠口碑：紐約市每家托兒中心的檢查紀錄都能免費查
title.en: Don't pick daycare on word of mouth alone: every NYC center's inspection record is free to look up

summary.zh-Hant: 托兒中心用市衛生局的 NYC Child Care Connect 查檢查紀錄，家庭托育用紐約州 OCFS 搜尋查執照狀態，請保母則是你當雇主，要照 IRS 與紐約州家務勞工法辦。市衛生局建議至少提前 3 個月開始找，嬰兒名額又少，所以孕中期就是起步的好時機。
summary.en: Look up centers' inspection records in the city's NYC Child Care Connect and home-based programs' license status in the state OCFS search; with a nanny, you become the employer under IRS and New York domestic worker rules. The city advises starting at least three months ahead and infant spots are scarce, so the second trimester is a good time to begin.

q.zh-Hant: 紐約市有執照的托兒中心，家長可以不先預約就去看孩子嗎？
q.en: Can parents drop in unannounced at a licensed NYC child care center?

a.zh-Hant: 原則上可以；除非法律或法院命令另有限制，家長可隨時探視入托的孩子，查看孩子使用的場所。
a.en: Generally yes. Parents may visit their enrolled child at any time and inspect areas the child uses, unless limited by law or court order.

q.zh-Hant: 托兒中心和家庭托育的檢查紀錄，分別去哪裡查？
q.en: Where do you look up records for a center versus home-based care?

a.zh-Hant: 托兒中心用紐約市衛生局的 NYC Child Care Connect；家庭托育和團體家庭托育用紐約州 OCFS 的托育搜尋。
a.en: Centers: the NYC Health Department's NYC Child Care Connect. Family and group family day care: the New York State OCFS child care search.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼懷孕中期就該開始找托育？
q.en: Why start looking for care in the second trimester?

a.zh-Hant: 市衛生局建議至少提前 3 個月找；審計長 2019 年的報告估計，名額只夠全市約 22% 的兩歲以下孩子。
a.en: The Health Department advises starting at least three months ahead, and a 2019 Comptroller report estimated spots for only about 22% of the city's children under two.

q.zh-Hant: 2026 年付給保母多少現金工資，就要開始付社會安全稅與醫療保險稅？
q.en: In 2026, how much cash pay to a nanny triggers Social Security and Medicare tax?

a.zh-Hant: 付給同一位家庭雇員 3,000 美元以上；雇主和保母各負擔 7.65%。
a.en: $3,000 or more to one household employee; employer and employee each pay 7.65%.

title.zh-Hant: 半夜醒來發現仰睡？別緊張，翻回側面再睡就好
title.en: Woke up on your back? Don't panic—roll onto your side

summary.zh-Hant: NIH 的孕早中期研究未發現睡姿與不良妊娠結果有顯著關聯，但不能據此認定 28 週後仰睡安全。NHS 建議從 28 週起側睡入睡，左右皆可；美國 MedlinePlus 在孕期也建議側睡。若醒來發現仰躺，不必驚慌，翻回側面就好。
summary.en: An NIH study found no significant association between sleep position and adverse outcomes in early/mid-pregnancy, but cannot establish that back sleeping is safe after 28 weeks. The NHS advises falling asleep on either side from week 28; U.S. MedlinePlus also recommends side sleeping during pregnancy. If you wake up on your back, simply turn onto your side.

q.zh-Hant: NHS 建議從懷孕第幾週起側睡入睡？
q.en: From what week does the NHS advise going to sleep on your side?

a.zh-Hant: 28 週以後；左側或右側都可以。
a.en: After 28 weeks; left or right side.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼現在（孕中期初）仰睡不用太擔心？
q.en: Why is back sleeping not a worry yet in early mid-pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: NIH 在孕早中期未發現顯著關聯，但無法證明孕晚期仰睡安全；從 28 週起依 NHS 建議側睡入睡。
a.en: The NIH study found no significant link early/mid-pregnancy, but cannot prove back sleeping is safe later. From week 28, settle on either side as NHS advises.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼仰睡在懷孕後期可能有影響？
q.en: Why might back sleeping matter late in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 一般認為和送到寶寶的血液與氧氣有關：變重的子宮可能壓迫主動脈和下腔靜脈。
a.en: It's thought to affect blood and oxygen reaching the baby: the heavier uterus may press on the aorta and inferior vena cava.

q.zh-Hant: 28 週後半夜醒來發現自己仰躺，該怎麼辦？
q.en: After 28 weeks, what should you do if you wake up on your back?

a.zh-Hant: 不用擔心，翻回側面再睡就好；研究看的是入睡時的姿勢。
a.en: Don't worry; just turn onto your side and go back to sleep. The studies looked at the position you fall asleep in.

title.zh-Hant: 你吃的菜，寶寶在羊水裡嚐得到：孕期就是第一堂味覺課
title.en: Your baby gets a taste of your dinner through the amniotic fluid: pregnancy is the first flavor lesson

summary.zh-Hant: 胎兒在孕晚期對胡蘿蔔與羽衣甘藍產生不同臉部反應。2025–2026 年的小型追蹤研究發現，嬰兒與 3 歲兒童對孕期熟悉的蔬菜氣味較少出現負面表情，但沒有證明會因此更愛吃蔬菜。孕期仍以均衡、多樣及食安為先。
summary.en: Late-pregnancy fetuses show different facial responses to carrot and kale exposure. Small 2025–2026 follow-ups found fewer negative facial reactions to familiar vegetable odors in infants and 3-year-olds, not proof that they eat more vegetables. A varied, balanced and safe pregnancy diet remains the priority.

q.zh-Hant: 胎兒怎麼接觸到媽媽吃下的味道？
q.en: How does a fetus encounter the flavors of what its mother eats?

a.zh-Hant: 味道經血液和胎盤進到羊水，胎兒吞下、吸入羊水時感覺到。
a.en: Flavors pass through the blood and placenta into the amniotic fluid, which the fetus swallows and breathes in.

q.zh-Hant: 胡蘿蔔／羽衣甘藍膠囊研究看到了什麼？
q.en: What did the carrot/kale capsule study see?

a.zh-Hant: 32 和 36 週時，羽衣甘藍組胎兒較常出現「哭臉」，胡蘿蔔組較常出現「笑臉」；但還無法判斷胎兒是否真的喜歡或討厭。
a.en: At 32 and 36 weeks, kale-group fetuses made more "cry faces" and carrot-group fetuses more "laughter faces," though it can't yet be told whether fetuses actually like or dislike them.

q.zh-Hant: 2026 年追蹤到 3 歲，是否證明孕期吃蔬菜會讓孩子長大更愛吃菜？
q.en: Did the 2026 follow-up prove that eating vegetables in pregnancy makes children eat more vegetables?

a.zh-Hant: 沒有。12 名 3 歲兒童在聞到孕晚期熟悉的蔬菜氣味時，負面臉部反應較少；但研究沒有測實際吃菜量，樣本也很小。
a.en: No. Twelve 3-year-olds made fewer negative facial expressions to familiar prenatal vegetable odors, but the study did not measure how much they ate and was very small.

q.zh-Hant: NHS 建議孕期每天吃多少蔬果？要注意什麼？
q.en: How much fruit and veg does the NHS advise in pregnancy, and what's the catch?

a.zh-Hant: 每天至少 5 份、種類多樣；生鮮蔬果要洗乾淨，因為土壤可能有弓形蟲。
a.en: At least 5 portions a day, varied; wash fresh produce, because soil can carry toxoplasma.

title.zh-Hant: 準爸爸也會憂鬱：研究估計約一成，孕期就值得留意
title.en: Expectant fathers can experience depression: roughly 1 in 10 in pooled studies

summary.zh-Hant: 研究綜合不同孕產期時點的調查，父親出現憂鬱症狀的比例約一成；這不是整段期間的累積發病機率。症狀可能從孕期開始，部分男性表現為易怒、退縮或飲酒增加。若情緒影響生活，應及早尋求協助，不必硬等兩週。
summary.en: Across surveys of different pregnancy and postpartum periods, roughly 1 in 10 fathers had depressive symptoms; this is not the cumulative risk of a new diagnosis across the whole period. Symptoms can begin during pregnancy, sometimes showing as irritability, withdrawal or heavier drinking. Seek help if mood affects daily life; there is no need to wait two weeks.

q.zh-Hant: 在 47 項研究的統合分析裡，父親憂鬱盛行率的點估計哪個時期最高？
q.en: In the 47-study meta-analysis, which period had the highest point estimate of depression prevalence?

a.zh-Hant: 伴侶懷孕的第一孕期約 13.6%；產後一年內研究整體約 8.8%。這些是不同樣本的點估計，不能證明個人在孕早期風險一定最高。
a.en: The first trimester, about 13.6%; postpartum-year studies overall, about 8.8%. These point estimates use different samples and do not prove that any individual's risk peaks in early pregnancy.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼一般的憂鬱問卷容易漏掉男性的憂鬱？
q.en: Why do standard depression questionnaires tend to miss depression in men?

a.zh-Hant: 因為男性常用逃避或麻木來掩飾，表現成易怒、攻擊性、喝酒或用藥，而不是說自己難過。
a.en: Because men often mask it by avoiding or numbing, showing irritability, aggression, or alcohol or drug use rather than saying they feel sad.

q.zh-Hant: 媽媽沒有憂鬱的話，爸爸的憂鬱還會影響孩子嗎？
q.en: If the mother isn't depressed, can the father's depression still affect the child?

a.zh-Hant: 研究在扣除媽媽的憂鬱後，仍看到父親產後憂鬱和較少親子共讀、較多體罰，以及孩子日後焦慮、行為和學業問題有關。
a.en: Yes. After accounting for maternal depression, studies still link fathers' postnatal depression to less reading and more physical punishment, and to children's later anxiety, behavior and school problems.

q.zh-Hant: 「產後情緒低落」和憂鬱怎麼分？
q.en: How do you tell the "baby blues" from depression?

a.zh-Hant: baby blues 多在幾天內緩解；症狀持續兩週尤其需要評估，但不能單靠時間診斷。若影響生活或有安全疑慮，應提早求助。
a.en: Baby blues often fade in days; symptoms lasting two weeks warrant assessment, but duration alone is not a diagnosis. Get help sooner if daily life or safety is affected.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶 6 個月前不能打流感疫苗：你現在打，抗體先替他擋
title.en: Babies can't get a flu shot until 6 months: get yours now and your antibodies cover them first

summary.zh-Hant: CDC 建議孕期任何一期都可以打流感針劑（不是鼻噴式）。媽媽的抗體會傳給寶寶；研究中，未滿 6 個月嬰兒的流感住院約少 4 成，未滿 3 個月時住院或急診少一半。
summary.en: CDC recommends the flu shot (not the nasal spray) in any trimester. Your antibodies pass to the baby: in one study, flu hospitalizations in infants under 6 months were about 40% lower, and hospital or ER visits under 3 months were cut by half.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼要媽媽在孕期打，而不是寶寶出生後自己打？
q.en: Why does the mother get the shot in pregnancy instead of the baby after birth?

a.zh-Hant: 寶寶未滿 6 個月不能打流感疫苗；孕期抗體是重要但不完整的保護，照顧者接種與避免接觸病人也很重要。
a.en: Infants under 6 months cannot get a flu shot. Maternal antibodies provide important but incomplete protection; caregiver vaccination and avoiding exposure also help.

q.zh-Hant: 孕期該打針劑還是鼻噴式流感疫苗？
q.en: In pregnancy, the flu shot or the nasal spray?

a.zh-Hant: 針劑。CDC 說孕期不要用鼻噴式流感疫苗。
a.en: The shot. CDC says not to use the nasal spray flu vaccine during pregnancy.

q.zh-Hant: 媽媽孕期打流感疫苗，寶寶未滿 6 個月的流感住院風險約少多少？未滿 3 個月呢？
q.en: How much does the mother's shot lower flu hospitalizations in babies under 6 months? And under 3 months?

a.zh-Hant: 觀察研究顯示：未滿 6 個月嬰兒的流感住院相對少約 40%；未滿 3 個月嬰兒的住院或急診相對少約一半，不代表絕對風險降 40 個百分點。
a.en: In an observational study: about 40% lower relative flu hospitalization among infants under 6 months, and about 50% lower hospitalization or ER visits under 3 months—not a 40-percentage-point absolute drop.

q.zh-Hant: 上一胎或去年打過，為什麼這次還要打？
q.en: You had one last year or last pregnancy. Why again?

a.zh-Hant: 每個流感季的疫苗會更新，成人通常每季打一劑；本季已接種的人，不需要只因後來懷孕就重打。
a.en: Flu vaccine strains change each season. Adults generally get one dose per season; pregnancy after this season's vaccination does not require a repeat dose.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶出院 2–3 天就要回診：小兒科醫師最好生產前就選好
title.en: Your newborn's first checkup comes 2–3 days after leaving the hospital: choose a pediatrician before the birth

summary.zh-Hant: 多數醫院在住院生產時就會問小兒科醫師是誰，出院後 48–72 小時要回診。AAP 建議孕晚期先跟醫師見一次面；孕中期正好列名單、確認保險網內。
summary.en: Most hospitals ask for your pediatrician's name when you're admitted, and the first checkup comes 48–72 hours after discharge. The AAP recommends meeting the pediatrician in the third trimester; the second trimester is the time to shortlist and check your insurance network.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶還沒出生，為什麼就要選好小兒科醫師？
q.en: Why choose a pediatrician before the baby is born?

a.zh-Hant: 多數醫院在住院時就會問醫師名字，寶寶一出生就會通知他或值班同事，出院後 48–72 小時就要回診。
a.en: Most hospitals ask for the name at admission, that doctor or the on-call associate is called as soon as the baby is born, and the first checkup comes 48–72 hours after discharge.

q.zh-Hant: AAP 建議什麼時候跟小兒科醫師第一次見面？
q.en: When does the AAP recommend first meeting the pediatrician?

a.zh-Hant: 第三孕期（孕晚期）的產前會面；這是唯一一次寶寶不用在場的例行健康檢查。
a.en: A prenatal visit in the third trimester, the only routine wellness visit where the child doesn't need to be there.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼出院後幾天就要回診？主要看什麼？
q.en: Why a checkup just days after discharge, and what's checked?

a.zh-Hant: 確認寶寶吃得夠：看體重（比出生時掉超過 10% 要進一步評估）、黃疸和脫水、尿布次數。
a.en: To make sure the baby is eating enough: weight (losing more than 10% of birth weight needs further evaluation), jaundice and dehydration, and diaper output.

q.zh-Hant: 打電話給診所，先篩掉不合的兩個問題是什麼？
q.en: Which two phone questions screen out offices fastest?

a.zh-Hant: 收不收新病人和我的保險？診所關門後寶寶有狀況，誰接電話？
a.en: Are you taking new patients with my insurance? Who answers if my baby has a problem after hours?

title.zh-Hant: 20 週超音波不只看性別：英國資料中，開放性脊柱裂約檢出 9 成、心臟問題約一半
title.en: The 20-week scan beyond sex: England's programme detects about 90% of open spina bifida but half of heart conditions

summary.zh-Hant: 結構超音波通常在 18–22 週，從腦、臉、心臟、脊椎到腎臟逐一檢查，也看胎盤和羊水。先發現就能先規劃生產；但它是篩檢不是診斷，結果正常也不代表所有問題都排除。
summary.en: The anatomy scan, usually at 18–22 weeks, checks the baby's brain, face, heart, spine and kidneys, plus the placenta and amniotic fluid. Finding a problem early lets you plan the birth, but it is screening, not diagnosis: a normal result doesn't rule out everything.

q.zh-Hant: 結構超音波通常在懷孕第幾週做？
q.en: When is the anatomy scan usually done?

a.zh-Hant: 美國通常 18–22 週（英國 NHS 是 18–21 週），約 30–45 分鐘。
a.en: Usually 18–22 weeks in the U.S. (18–21 in England's NHS), taking about 30–45 minutes.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼結果正常，也不能保證寶寶完全沒問題？
q.en: Why can't a normal scan guarantee the baby has no problems?

a.zh-Hant: 有些狀況照不出來：英格蘭 NHS 數據中開放性脊柱裂約找到 90%，心臟問題只約 50%；它是篩檢，不是診斷。
a.en: Some conditions don't show: in England's NHS figures it finds about 90% of open spina bifida but only about 50% of heart conditions. It's screening, not diagnosis.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼在出生前發現問題有幫助？
q.en: Why does finding a condition before birth help?

a.zh-Hant: 可以事先規劃生產和產後照護；需要很快動手術的寶寶，能安排在出生後幾小時內就能開刀的醫院生產。
a.en: You can plan the birth and aftercare in advance, and a baby who will need surgery soon after birth can be delivered at a hospital that can operate within the first few hours.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼 FDA 不鼓勵另外去照「紀念超音波」？
q.en: Why does the FDA discourage keepsake ultrasounds?

a.zh-Hant: 超音波會讓組織稍微升溫，長期影響仍不清楚；醫療檢查中順便留影像可以，但不要為了紀念額外照射。
a.en: Ultrasound can heat tissue slightly and the long-term effects are unknown. Images from a medically needed exam are fine; extra exposure just for keepsakes isn't.

title.zh-Hant: 生產課不一定孕晚期才開：先查醫院課表，別把英國時程當通則
title.en: Childbirth classes do not all follow the same timetable: check local options early

summary.zh-Hant: 英國 NHS 產前課常在出生前 8–10 週開始，但紐約醫院的課程日期、長度和形式不同，不能套用英國時程。美國衛生部建議在預產期前幾個月報名；產前課可幫助準備，但不能保證特定生產結果。
summary.en: In the UK, NHS classes often start 8–10 weeks before birth. New York hospitals offer varied class lengths, schedules and online options; U.S. guidance suggests booking several months ahead. Classes can help with preparation, but no birth outcome is guaranteed.

q.zh-Hant: 英國 NHS 產前課通常何時開始？美國應何時查詢與報名？
q.en: When do NHS classes usually start, and when should you book in the U.S.?

a.zh-Hant: 英國 NHS：常在出生前 8–10 週開始、每週約 2 小時；紐約課程形式各異，應查當地課表。美國衛生部建議預產期前幾個月報名。
a.en: UK NHS: classes often start 8–10 weeks before birth, about 2 hours weekly; check the local New York schedule. U.S. Office on Women's Health: book several months before the due date.

q.zh-Hant: 為何孕中期就該查課，而不是假定每家醫院都在孕晚期開課？
q.en: Why look in the second trimester rather than assume every class starts in the third?

a.zh-Hant: 有些課可能額滿；英國 NHS 提供 8–10 週的例子，但紐約醫院的課程時間與長度不同，應按當地檔期安排。
a.en: Some classes fill quickly; the NHS 8–10-week example is not a fixed New York schedule, so book based on your local provider's dates.

q.zh-Hant: 研究怎麼說生產課的效果？
q.en: What does research say about how much classes help?

a.zh-Hant: Cochrane（2007，9 項試驗）認為整體效果尚不明確；2023 年回顧指出可能減少恐懼與產痛。2026 年回顧（28 項研究）發現恐懼減少，但孕期恐懼證據確定性低，不能保證個人結果。
a.en: Cochrane (2007, 9 trials) found overall effects uncertain; a 2023 review suggested less fear and pain. A 2026 review (28 studies) found reduced fear but low-certainty evidence for antenatal fear; individual outcomes are not guaranteed.

q.zh-Hant: 報了生產課，為什麼還要看有沒有哺乳和新生兒課？
q.en: You've booked a birth class, so why check for breastfeeding and newborn classes too?

a.zh-Hant: 醫院常把它們拆開：例如西奈山的新生兒課不談哺乳，哺乳是另一堂 2 小時的課。
a.en: Hospitals often split them: Mount Sinai's newborn class doesn't cover breastfeeding, which is a separate 2-hour class.

title.zh-Hant: 壓力大會傷到寶寶嗎？日常緊張很正常，要處理的是「又大又久」的那種
title.en: Will stress hurt the baby? Everyday tension is normal; the heavy, lasting kind is what to deal with

summary.zh-Hant: 孕期有些壓力是正常的；和低出生體重、早產有關的是嚴重或長期的壓力，可能透過睡眠、血壓、免疫和紓壓行為影響懷孕。放鬆練習的試驗顯示能降低媽媽的壓力與焦慮分數，對寶寶的好處證據還有限。
summary.en: Some stress in pregnancy is normal. Serious or long-lasting stress is what's linked to low birthweight and preterm birth, possibly through sleep, blood pressure, immunity and coping habits. Relaxation trials show lower stress and anxiety scores for mothers; evidence for the baby is more limited.

q.zh-Hant: 孕期有壓力就會傷到寶寶嗎？
q.en: Does any stress in pregnancy harm the baby?

a.zh-Hant: 不代表一定會。孕期有些壓力是正常的；較值得處理的是嚴重或長期的壓力，例如重大變故、經濟困難、憂鬱或焦慮。
a.en: Not necessarily. Some stress in pregnancy is normal. More serious or long-lasting stress deserves attention, such as a major loss, money problems, depression or anxiety.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼心理壓力會影響到懷孕？
q.en: Why can psychological stress affect a pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 它會改變身體和行為：睡眠、食慾變差，血壓可能升高（和早產、低出生體重有關），免疫力受影響，或用抽菸喝酒來應付。確切機制還沒完全弄清楚。
a.en: It changes your body and habits: worse sleep and appetite, possibly higher blood pressure (linked to preterm labor and low birthweight), immune effects, or coping by smoking or drinking. The exact mechanism isn't fully understood.

q.zh-Hant: 2018 年統合分析發現，孕期壓力和什麼的關聯最清楚？
q.en: In the 2018 meta-analysis, what was stress in pregnancy most clearly linked to?

a.zh-Hant: 低出生體重（勝算約 1.68 倍，8 項研究）。早產的結果不一致，而且都是關聯，不是因果證明。
a.en: Low birthweight (odds ratio about 1.68, 8 studies). Results for preterm birth were inconsistent, and all of it is association, not proof of cause.

q.zh-Hant: 放鬆練習（瑜伽、深呼吸、音樂等）的研究證據怎麼說？
q.en: What does the evidence say about relaxation practices like yoga, breathing and music?

a.zh-Hant: 2024 年回顧（32 項研究）發現媽媽的壓力、焦慮、憂鬱分數降低；出生體重平均多約 80 公克，主要由肌肉放鬆和深呼吸研究帶動，不能推論每種方法都有相同效果。
a.en: A 2024 review of 32 studies found lower maternal stress, anxiety and depression scores. Birthweight averaged about 80 g higher, mainly in muscle-relaxation and breathing trials; this does not mean every method has that effect.

title.zh-Hant: 過節要出遠門？懷孕時長途坐著，最該防的是腿上的血栓
title.en: Traveling for the holidays? On long rides in pregnancy, the thing to guard against is a clot in your leg

summary.zh-Hant: 孕中期通常可以旅行。懷孕讓血液比較容易凝結，長時間坐著會再提高腿部血栓的機會，所以大約每小時起來走一走、多喝水；開車時安全帶腰帶要繫在肚子下方，出門前先查航空或郵輪的週數規定並帶好產檢紀錄。
summary.en: Mid-pregnancy travel is usually fine. Pregnancy makes blood clot more easily and long sitting adds to the risk of a leg clot, so get up and walk about every hour and drink fluids. In the car, the lap belt goes under the bump; before you go, check airline or cruise week limits and pack your prenatal records.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼懷孕會讓血比較容易凝結？
q.en: Why does pregnancy make blood clot more easily?

a.zh-Hant: 身體為了減少分娩時失血，讓血液比較容易凝結；孕後期骨盆血管受壓也可能影響腿部血流。CDC 估計靜脈血栓相對風險約為未懷孕時的五倍，但絕對風險仍低；孕期、分娩及產後 3 個月都應留意。
a.en: Blood clots more readily to limit blood loss at delivery; pelvic vessel compression later in pregnancy may also reduce leg blood flow. CDC estimates about five times the relative risk of venous clots versus nonpregnancy, but absolute risk remains low. Be alert during pregnancy, delivery and the following 3 months.

q.zh-Hant: 懷孕時安全帶的腰帶和肩帶各要放在哪裡？
q.en: Where do the lap belt and shoulder belt go in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 腰帶在肚子下方，貼著髖部和骨盆骨；肩帶斜過胸前、從兩側乳房之間通過。絕不放在肚子上、手臂下或背後，安全氣囊保持開啟。
a.en: The lap belt goes below the belly, across the hips and pelvic bone; the shoulder belt crosses the chest between the breasts. Never over the belly, under the arm or behind the back, and leave the airbags on.

q.zh-Hant: 長途旅行時多久該起來動一次？
q.en: On a long trip, how often should you get up and move?

a.zh-Hant: 安全時約每小時走動，NHS 建議飛行時約每 30 分鐘活動；不能起身時做小腿運動。保持水分，但喝水不能取代活動，壓力襪先問醫師。
a.en: Walk about hourly when safe; the NHS suggests moving about every 30 minutes on a flight. Exercise your calves while seated if you cannot stand. Stay hydrated, but water is no substitute for movement; ask about compression stockings.

q.zh-Hant: 旅途中哪些症狀代表要馬上就醫？
q.en: Which symptoms on a trip mean getting care right away?

a.zh-Hant: 疑似肺栓塞（突然呼吸困難、胸痛或咳血）立即打 911（國外用當地急救電話）。一側腿腫痛、發熱發紅應立即聯絡醫療團隊評估。出血、破水、持續嚴重腹痛或子癇前症警訊也應立即就醫。
a.en: For possible PE (sudden breathing trouble, chest pain or coughing blood), call 911 or the local emergency number. For one-sided leg swelling, pain, warmth or redness, contact your care team immediately for assessment. Bleeding, leaking fluid, persistent severe abdominal pain or preeclampsia warning signs also need immediate care.

q.zh-Hant: 航空公司通常讓孕婦飛到幾週？要準備什麼？
q.en: How late in pregnancy do airlines usually let you fly, and what should you prepare?

a.zh-Hant: 有些到 36 週，有些更早就不行，要問各家航空。NHS 說 28 週後可能要醫師確認預產期、沒有併發症風險的信，開信可能要等幾週。
a.en: Some allow flying until 36 weeks, others stop earlier, so ask each airline. The NHS says after 28 weeks an airline may want a letter confirming your due date and that you are not at risk of complications, which can take weeks to get.

title.zh-Hant: 趁特價買嬰兒用品前：床圍和斜躺睡床已禁售，二手嬰兒床光看看不出合不合格
title.en: Before the holiday baby-gear sales: bumpers and inclined sleepers are banned, and you can't see whether a used crib is safe

summary.zh-Hant: 寶寶睡覺的地方只要堅固平坦的床墊加一張床包。床圍和斜度超過 10 度的斜躺睡床自 2022 年起禁售，AAP 也建議避開定位枕、軟墊和毯子；二手嬰兒床要有合格證明，二手汽車座椅要通過 NHTSA 的 5 項檢查，買了記得註冊以收到召回通知。
summary.en: A baby's sleep space needs only a firm, flat mattress and a fitted sheet. Bumpers and inclined sleepers over 10 degrees have been banned since 2022, and AAP says to skip positioners, soft add-ons and blankets. A used crib needs a certificate of compliance, a used car seat must pass NHTSA's 5 checks, and registering new gear gets you recall notices.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼現在的嬰兒床不需要床圍？
q.en: Why don't today's cribs need bumpers?

a.zh-Hant: 安全規定要求欄杆間距很窄，所以 AAP 說床圍沒有必要；床圍和斜躺睡床自 2022 年 11 月 12 日起是聯邦禁售品。
a.en: Safety rules call for narrow rail spacing, so AAP says bumpers are unnecessary; bumpers and inclined sleepers have been federally banned since November 12, 2022.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶安全的睡眠空間裡應該有什麼？
q.en: What belongs in a safe sleep space?

a.zh-Hant: 堅固平坦的床墊加一張床包，寶寶仰睡；怕冷用穿式睡袋，不放毯子、枕頭、玩偶或床圍。
a.en: A firm, flat mattress with a fitted sheet and the baby on their back; a sleep sack for warmth, and no blankets, pillows, toys or bumpers.

q.zh-Hant: 二手嬰兒床能不能用看的判斷是否安全？
q.en: Can you judge a used crib's safety by looking?

a.zh-Hant: 不能。要向製造商或賣家拿合格證明（16 CFR 1219 或 1220）；活動側欄嬰兒床加了固定器也不符合標準。
a.en: No. Ask the maker or seller for a certificate of compliance (16 CFR 1219 or 1220); a drop-side crib doesn't comply even with an immobilizer.

q.zh-Hant: 二手汽車座椅要通過哪 5 項檢查？
q.en: What are the 5 checks for a used car seat?

a.zh-Hant: 從未發生中度到嚴重車禍、有製造日期和型號標籤、沒有召回、零件齊全、有說明書。
a.en: Never in a moderate to severe crash, labels with manufacture date and model number, no recalls, all its parts, and the instruction book.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶這幾週開始長細毛，再裹上一層白色胎脂：出生後第一次洗澡，可以等 24 小時
title.en: Your baby is starting to grow fine hair, then a waxy white coat: after birth, the first bath can wait 24 hours

summary.zh-Hant: 胎毛約在孕中期長出，幫胎脂黏在皮膚上，一起替寶寶保溫、防水，多半在出生前脫落。胎脂有保濕作用，WHO 建議第一次洗澡等到出生 24 小時後，做不到至少等 6 小時，可降低著涼和低血糖的機會；臍帶掉之前只擦澡。
summary.en: Lanugo grows in the second trimester and holds vernix on the skin, keeping the baby warm and waterproofed; most of it sheds before birth. Vernix moisturizes, and WHO recommends waiting 24 hours for the first bath, or at least 6, which may lower the chance of getting cold or low blood sugar. Sponge baths only until the cord falls off.

q.zh-Hant: 胎兒為什麼要長胎毛？
q.en: Why does a fetus grow lanugo?

a.zh-Hant: 為了保護和保暖：胎毛讓胎脂黏在皮膚上，一起替身體保溫、保護皮膚不被羊水泡壞。
a.en: For protection and warmth: it holds vernix on the skin, and together they insulate the body and shield the skin from the amniotic fluid.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼新生兒第一次洗澡要等？等多久？
q.en: Why wait to give a newborn the first bath, and for how long?

a.zh-Hant: 太早洗容易著涼（低體溫），也可能讓血糖下降；胎脂還能保濕。WHO 建議等 24 小時，做不到至少等 6 小時。
a.en: An early bath makes a baby more likely to get cold (hypothermia) and can lower blood sugar, and vernix moisturizes the skin. WHO says wait 24 hours, or at least 6 if a full day isn't possible.

q.zh-Hant: 新生兒什麼時候可以開始泡澡？
q.en: When can a newborn have a tub bath?

a.zh-Hant: 臍帶殘端掉了（通常 1–2 週）、肚臍癒合之後。之前只擦澡。
a.en: After the cord stump falls off (usually by 1–2 weeks) and the belly button heals. Until then, sponge baths only.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶出生時肩膀上還有細毛，需要擔心嗎？
q.en: Your baby is born with fine hair on the shoulders. Is that a worry?

a.zh-Hant: 不用。足月時上臂和肩膀常還留一些，早產兒更常見；通常出生後兩個月內就會消失。
a.en: No. At term some often remains on the upper arms and shoulders, more so in premature babies, and it usually disappears within two months.
